from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metadata from a single judgment document relevant to case cause classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The official case cause (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_records: list[JudgmentRecord]
